characters.bio: A robot who hosts the show

subtitles.t: Come on in. Welcome to "경복궁" Palace.
Letters are a promise. They are letters only when everyone can read them together.
Oh, so if I am the only one who knows them, they aren't letters.
Then who decided on that promise?
King "세종대왕". Five hundred years ago, the king made them himself. Back then, ordinary people did not know letters. The letters were too hard.
Wow! Then everyone must have liked it!
No. The king's officials were against it.
Because back then, only people who knew letters had power.
Then what about us? Can we read too?
Now, please look here. This is that letter. It is "아".
So that is what "세종대왕" wanted to do. Letters that anyone can read easily. And right now, those people are us.
